subject: Senior Backend Interview — same-day positive test, convert to recorded exercise
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gmail.com>, BrightBridge Talent <recruiter@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Feb 2028 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Senior Backend interview — panel confirmation (Fri 10:00am PST)

Hi Asha —

Quick confirmation that your onsite loop for Senior Backend Engineer is set for today, Fri Feb 2 at 10:00am PST (panel: Laura, Marcus, Grace). We have a 60-minute schedule: system design + bar-raise coding round + 30-min debrief buffer. Please aim to arrive 10 minutes early for check-in; panel will be remote/hybrid depending on the interviewer's location.

Attached is the candidate packet (agenda + parking map) and the calendar invite (I sent the ics to your email). If anything changes, let me know ASAP — we can convert to a remote session or swap to a recorded coding exercise in a pinch.

Thanks and see you soon,

--
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiting Coordinator | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0128
[Attachment: candidate_packet.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
[Attachment: calendar_invite.ics (ICS, 2KB)]

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, BrightBridge Talent <recruiter@brightbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Feb 2028 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Senior Backend interview — panel confirmation (Fri 10:00am PST)

Hi Marissa —

Really sorry to do this last minute — I just took a rapid antigen before heading out and it came back positive. I have a low-grade fever and won't be able to make the in-person interview today. I feel fine otherwise and am happy to do a remote/phone loop, or I can complete a recorded coding exercise if that's easier for the team.

If postponing is preferred I can do early next week any day after Wed (PST). Also — I paid for an expedited test at the clinic this morning; if Redwood has a reimbursement process for day-of travel/testing costs, please let me know what you need.

Apologies again for the disruption. I'm still very excited about the role and want to keep the process moving.

Thanks,
Asha
asha.rao@gmail.com | (650) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gmail.com>, BrightBridge Talent <recruiter@brightbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Feb 2028 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Senior Backend interview — same-day positive test (options)

Team — forwarding Asha's note. She just tested positive this morning and can't come in. Two proposed paths from my side: 

1) Convert today's session to an async/recorded coding exercise + 48-hour window for delivery. We provide the problem, a 90-minute timed window for her to record her screen/code walk, and a self-upload to our S3 upload link. We would then treat that as the 'coding round' portion and the panel would still meet for a debrief. I can assemble the exercise and instructions — see attached draft instructions.

2) Postpone the live loop to next week (Asha said "any day after Wed PST"). If we postpone, we should try to preserve the same interviewers; I can look for availabilities. 

Also: Asha mentioned an expedited test expense. We reimburse reasonable day-of expenses for travel/tests — we require a receipt and the quick expense form. I'll attach the reimbursement PDF and include the link.

Recommend option 1 if the team is comfortable evaluating a recorded exercise — it's faster for the candidate and keeps momentum. Marcus/Laura — any strong preference? If you approve option 1, I'll send the exercise + instructions and cancel the onsite calendar (invite attached).

Thanks,
Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiting Coordinator | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: recording_instructions.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
[Attachment: expense_reimbursement_form.pdf (PDF, 18KB)]
[Attachment: calendar_invite.ics (ICS, removed)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha.rao@gmail.com>, BrightBridge Talent <recruiter@brightbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Feb 2028 12:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Senior Backend interview — same-day positive test (convert to recorded)

Thanks for flagging, Marissa — and Asha, thank you for the heads-up and for offering options. 

Laura here (hiring manager). We're fine converting today's coding portion to the recorded exercise — we'll accept the recording as the coding round and proceed with a 30-minute remote debrief (video call) afterwards if needed. Please follow Marissa's attached instructions and upload within 48 hours. 

Marissa: please send the timed problem (90-minute window), S3 upload link, and the rubric we'll use for review. Also confirm that we will reimburse Asha for the test — payroll will need the filled expense_reimbursement_form.pdf + the receipt. I will waive the additional live panel for now; we'll review the recording and decide whether a short follow-up call is needed. 

Asha — fully understand. Hope you feel better soon. No need to come in until you have a negative test and feel well. If you prefer to postpone instead of doing the recording, let Marissa know and she'll reschedule.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director of Engineering, Backend | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
[Attachment: candidate_packet.pdf (removed for update)]
